In 1997, LAPD officers confront heavily armed shooters in a relentless bank robbery battle on Laurel Canyon Blvd, risking their lives.
NYPD Homicide Detectives have very little to go on as they search for a sexual predator; unraveling one of New York City's most disturbing murder cases.
In 1989, Detectives Brian Jarvis and David Taylor race to solve a string of murders targeting middle-aged men along Florida highways.
As Cpl. Meehan investigates Keith Johansen's claim of his wife's accidental shooting, inconsistencies emerge, unveiling a chilling pattern of abuse.
The murder of an iconic pizzeria owner in Brooklyn uncovers alleged mafia ties, FBI involvement, and an unexpected suspect through surveillance.
When a young couple is shot in their own driveway, the Wayne County Sheriff ties it to a disgraced former law enforcement officer from Texas.
Top-notch police work across states brings two bad cops and a manipulative accomplice to justice in this double murder that was all about the kids.
After five previous attempts, Sylvester "Sally Daz" Zottlola is whacked in the Bronx. Homicide gathers evidence that points toward Bloods gang members.
NYPD Detectives Luis Yero and Rich Lyman find that vengeance is the motivation for a spate of cold-blooded, seemingly unrelated murders in Brooklyn.
In '90s Miami, Sgt. Nelson Andreu and Det. Carlos Avila pursue a ritualistic serial killer preying on unhoused women.
Robert Hansen a mild-mannered family man, kidnapped and tortured women and flew them out to his cabin, where he set them loose in the Alaskan wilderness, and hunted them down for sport.
Environmentalist Louis Hastings wants to blow up the Alaskan Pipeline but wants to eliminate possible witnesses first. He stalks his victims one by one, determined to carry out his murderous plan.
The remote Chulitna is the perfect spot for rafting, fishing, and murder. When a couple is reported missing, troopers discover they’re the victims of cold-blooded murder and begin a manhunt.
Manley Hot Springs, Alaska is a remote mountain hide-a-way known for its solitude. That innocent existence is shattered when a newcomer goes on a rampage and guns down residents one by one.

When a Michigan woman is shot to death, investigators write it off as a hunting accident. But the case heats up when police discover that the woman's husband had taken out a huge amount of life insurance on her before her death.
A look at the controversial case of North Carolina author Michael Peterson, convicted of murdering his wife, a high powered business executive.

After 17 years in prison, Marty Tankleff is finally free and his almost-two-decade tragic journey has ended and become national news. 19 years ago, 17-year-old Marty was accused of murdering his parents.

In the Depression-torn dust bowl of the 1930s, a new kind of desperado is born. Pretty Boy Floyd, John Dillinger, and Bonnie & Clyde become as well-known and admired as movie stars. Bill Kurtis narrates their murderous rise and deadly fall

The Prohibition Act of 1919 turns the petty vice and extortion gangs into criminal armies and helps sow the seeds of what will become the great crime syndicates. Brooklyn D.A. Charles Hynes is interviewed.
By the mid-1930s, law enforcement is outgunned and uncoordinated. Any state line provides a sanctuary for a fleeing hoodlum, setting the stage for a kidnapping wave.
The Mafia builds its own world--nightclubs, racetracks, and casinos--and climbs to the highest levels of power. Vito Genovese accompanies General Patton.

A store manager and his staff are held up and shot by two killers. An 18-year-old has both his arms torn off in an accident on the family farm. A 17-year-old girl is kidnapped and assaulted by a serial killer.
On their first date, a young woman and her friend are shot execution style at a deserted reservoir; two strangers' lives collide when they are caught up in a deadly train collision.

"It's one of the strangest cases in FBI history. A Pennsylvania pizza delivery driver claims he was delivering an order when a group of men attacked him, put a bomb on him and forced him to rob a bank. Is he an innocent hostage or a co-conspirator? "

Three weeks after the bombing death of Pennsylvania pizza delivery driver Brian Wells, a man tells investigators that there's a dead body in his freezer, right next to the location where Brian delivered pizzas just before he robbed the bank.

Annie Le, a brilliant Yale PhD student, vanishes days before her wedding. CCTV cameras catch Le entering her research lab but there's no trace of her leaving. The FBI uncovers a dark secret that exposes the shocking truth behind her disappearance.

"A trail of bodies leads to a manhunt for a suspected serial killer. When fashion designer Gianni Versace is murdered outside of his home, law enforcement connects it to their elusive killer. Will the FBI find their man before he strikes again? "

"Eight veterans die mysteriously at a VA hospital. After conducting hundreds of interviews, poring over medical charts and electronic records and exhuming the victims' bodies, the FBI discovers the killer comes from inside the hospital itself. "

After eight patients die at a VA Hospital, evidence points to a killer on staff. She was on duty during the deaths; autopsies discover fatal injections of insulin; and evidence reveals a fascination with killing. Now, they must get a confession.

As the FBI's list of missing persons in the Boulder area grows, investigators follow a trail of chilling evidence that unexpectedly leads them to someone within their ranks. What they thought was a valuable asset turns out to be a master manipulator.

After the shocking acquittal of Miami's drug kingpins, authorities suspect that they conspired to infiltrate and obstruct the justice system. Through informants and undercover ops., the FBI uncover a vast web of money, murder, and corruption.

The FBI receives a tip that Sal Magluta's bookkeeper is laundering millions of dollars for the Magluta-Falcon drug organization. When she flees Miami, the FBI uncovers a money laundering scheme that could take down the entire organization.
